contradictions.what: Rep first named Maya as final decider ('her call'), then revealed Greg held and signed the contract; revised to Maya chose, Greg decided whether anyone was chosen.
Rep thought they were there to keep the incumbent honest, yet the deal signed four days after the data session.
Customer questions shifted to hardware and front-desk, yet what was signed was online billing only; the area the questions focused on remains with Global.
